aiAssistant.title: AI Assistant — Data Insights
aiAssistant.heading: 🤖 AI Assistant
aiAssistant.intro: Ask me about your data sources, metrics, and insights!
aiAssistant.greeting: 👋 Hi! I'm your digital assistant for data insights. I can help you analyze your data sources, build dashboards, and investigate issues. What would you like to explore today?

mock.q1: Show me validation error trends for the last week
mock.a1:
I analyzed validation errors for the last week. Here is what I found:

📊 **Error Summary:**
• Total errors: 1,247 (↓ 15% from previous week)
• Most common error type: missing required field (42%)
• Worst-performing data source: Customer Feedback Forms (28%)
mock.q2: Why do customer feedback forms have so many errors?
mock.a2:
I investigated the Customer Feedback Forms data source. The main issues are:

🔍 **Root Causes:**
• Schema was updated on Sept 15, but old format is still being submitted
• 67% of errors are in the email field (validation pattern mismatch)
• Most submissions come from mobile devices with autofill issues
mock.thinkingResponse: Thank you for your question! I am working on the data and will respond shortly with a detailed answer.

aiAssistant.placeholder: Ask about data sources, metrics, or request insights...
